pages: Tama Roberts, a boy of fifteen, dark hair under a faded black beanie, a green waterproof jacket and muddy gumboots, stands at the last pile of the old oyster wharf and reads the water. Middle distance: a thermos, a folded tide table. Background: mud flats to the horizon under a very low sky.

Tama Roberts, a boy of fifteen, dark hair under a faded black beanie, a green waterproof jacket and muddy gumboots, runs one fingertip down a pencil-marked strip of hardwood tide staff leaning against the pile and writes in his exercise book. Middle distance: barnacled timber, a thermos. Background: grey harbour water, flat overcast light.

Tama Roberts, a boy of fifteen, dark hair under a faded black beanie, a green waterproof jacket and muddy gumboots, stands at the edge of the flat with his tide staff planted in the mud, watching water come in through one narrow gap in the bank. Middle distance: mussel shells, a marker stick. Background: the flooded flat, low sky.

Tama Roberts, a boy of fifteen, dark hair under a faded black beanie, a green waterproof jacket and muddy gumboots, crouches at a block of concrete set in the creek bank and lays one fingertip beside the brass survey disc in its top. Middle distance: a steel pole, a folded rule. Background: creek water, salt grass, flat daylight.

Tama Roberts, a boy of fifteen, dark hair under a faded black beanie, a green waterproof jacket and muddy gumboots, stands at the wharf end with one hardback exercise book open in his hands, looking over the drying flat. Middle distance: bracken clumps, cracked mud. Background: the far bank, pale winter light.

Tama Roberts, a boy of fifteen, dark hair under a faded black beanie, a green waterproof jacket and muddy gumboots, stands in the wharf shed and lifts one corner of a clear plastic sheet with a fingertip, uncovering the plan board behind it. Middle distance: a nail, a folded chair. Background: shed boards, a dusty window.

Tama Roberts, a boy of fifteen, dark hair under a faded black beanie, a green waterproof jacket and muddy gumboots, stands at the back of the wharf shed with one hardback exercise book open, reading his own figures from it. Middle distance: a folding table, stacked chairs. Background: a whiteboard on the wall, daylight from a high window.

Tama Roberts, a boy of fifteen, dark hair under a faded black beanie, a green waterproof jacket and muddy gumboots, crouches at a steel pole on the creek bank and rubs mud off the small metal plate that carries an arrow. Middle distance: the concrete block, a spade. Background: the creek and the eaten bank, overcast light.

Tama Roberts, a boy of fifteen, dark hair under a faded black beanie, a green waterproof jacket and muddy gumboots, writes one single figure in his exercise book with a carpenter's pencil, sitting on the concrete block. Middle distance: the brass disc, a folding rule. Background: creek water and mud, flat daylight.

Tama Roberts, a boy of fifteen, dark hair under a faded black beanie, a green waterproof jacket and muddy gumboots, sets one spirit level across the top of the concrete block and watches the bubble, his cheek near the timber. Middle distance: a scrap of timber, the steel pole. Background: the creek bank, soft grey light.

Tama Roberts, a boy of fifteen, dark hair under a faded black beanie, a green waterproof jacket and muddy gumboots, holds one plumb line against the leaning pile and sights down it, barnacles thick below the tide band. Middle distance: an open tool roll, the waterline. Background: harbour water, grey sky.

Tama Roberts, a boy of fifteen, dark hair under a faded black beanie, a green waterproof jacket and muddy gumboots, kneels in the mud beside the pile and writes in his open exercise book balanced on his knee. Middle distance: the leaning pile, weed at his boots. Background: flat water and sky, low light.

Tama Roberts, a boy of fifteen, dark hair under a faded black beanie, a green waterproof jacket and muddy gumboots, kneels on the shed step and cuts one galvanised pipe with a cold chisel. Middle distance: the pipe offcut, a sledge on the grass. Background: the shed wall, mud, clear morning light.

Tama Roberts, a boy of fifteen, dark hair under a faded black beanie, a green waterproof jacket and muddy gumboots, screws one brass nut onto the threaded rod at the top of the pipe and steadies it with his fingertips. Middle distance: a tin of sanding seal, an open toolbox. Background: the shed step, low sun.

Tama Roberts, a boy of fifteen, dark hair under a faded black beanie, a green waterproof jacket and muddy gumboots, stands back from one galvanised pipe driven upright in the marsh mud and sights down it for plumb. Middle distance: a sledge, the plumb line. Background: the flat and a low horizon, evening light.

Tama Roberts, a boy of fifteen, dark hair under a faded black beanie, a green waterproof jacket and muddy gumboots, paints the flat top of one galvanised pipe standing in the marsh mud, brush and open tin of seal in his hands. Middle distance: weed at his boots, a hardwood wedge. Background: the wet flat, high thin light.

Tama Roberts, a boy of fifteen, dark hair under a faded black beanie, a green waterproof jacket and muddy gumboots, writes one column of tide numbers in his open exercise book, the sill pipe beside his knee. Middle distance: a thermos, pencil stubs. Background: water lying over the flat, pale dawn light.

Tama Roberts, a boy of fifteen, dark hair under a faded black beanie, a green waterproof jacket and muddy gumboots, stands at a table in the wharf shed with one folded survey sheet spread open before him. Middle distance: a photocopy of a graph, the plan board. Background: shed boards, a dusty window, flat light.

Tama Roberts, a boy of fifteen, dark hair under a faded black beanie, a green waterproof jacket and muddy gumboots, kneels in the mud at the sill and lays one hand on its painted flat top, checking its height. Middle distance: the brass disc on its block, a folding staff. Background: the creek, low afternoon light.

Tama Roberts, a boy of fifteen, dark hair under a faded black beanie, a green waterproof jacket and muddy gumboots, sets one folding levelling staff upright on the marsh mud and reads it against the brass disc. Middle distance: the concrete block, a book of figures. Background: the creek bank, bright flat light.

Tama Roberts, a boy of fifteen, dark hair under a faded black beanie, a green waterproof jacket and muddy gumboots, stands in the shed doorway with one hardback exercise book open flat in his hands, showing the figures. Middle distance: the folding table, a rolled sheet. Background: the plan board, daylight behind him.

Tama Roberts, a boy of fifteen, dark hair under a faded black beanie, a green waterproof jacket and muddy gumboots, crouches at the rusted sill pipe out in the mud and writes in his exercise book on his knee. Middle distance: a pencil, the orange nut at its top. Background: the flat in low sun, long grass.

Tama Roberts, a boy of fifteen, dark hair under a faded black beanie, a green waterproof jacket and muddy gumboots, sits on the wharf deck with one hand flat on the closed cover of an old exercise book. Middle distance: a pencil, the last pile. Background: mud flats, low evening light.

Tama Roberts, a boy of fifteen, dark hair under a faded black beanie, a green waterproof jacket and muddy gumboots, writes with a pencil in one new hardback exercise book held open on his knee. Middle distance: the old worn exercise book, the folded tide table. Background: the last pile and the mud flats, grey morning light.
